title: Has anyone else been to this mall world?
content: It’s so similar to this one, but the bottom floor with the tattoo shop and metaphysical store are more underground, almost a Moroccan behind a beaded curtain vibe? And you’re able to go into the ship, and inside the ship it’s an endless loop of hallways with stores everywhere. This is the closest I’ve been able to articulate where I’m at within the dreams. And I always feel like I’m running from something
